description: Erection of a full width single storey rear extension with sukkah roof and rear outrigger dormer.
decision_conditions:
<p>All new external facing and roofing materials in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works carried out in this connection) shall match those of the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance including type, size, colour, bond, pointing, coursing, jointing, profile and texture, notwithstanding the details provided on the approved plans.&nbsp;</p><p>

REASON:&nbsp;To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.</p>

The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p>Prior to superstructure works, detailed specification, a drainage layout and a management &amp; maintenance plan of the water butt with overflow, shall be submitted to, and approved by the LPA, in consultation with the LLFA.</p><p>REASON: In the interest of sustainable urban drainage.</p>

Prior to occupation, at least one bird/bat box shall be provided close to the eaves and shall be retained thereafter. REASON: To support bird and bat populations, including swifts, in Hackney and preserve endangered urban biodiversity, by providing nesting opportunities, in accordance with Hackney’s Local Plan LP33 policy LP47 which states that all development schemes involving buildings with an eaves height or roof commencement height of 5 metres and above are required to provide nesting boxes for swifts, sparrows, starlings, and/or bats as appropriate.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until at least one form of biodiversity uplift has been provided at the site through the addition of a green roof. The biodiversity enhancement installed shall be thereafter retained with a minimum substrate depth of 80-100mm excluding the vegetative mat. REASON: In the interests of promoting biodiversity at the site, in line with Hackney's Local Plan LP33, policy LP46.
